sources.review_scope: Official JPL page, selected steps3–4 and Kepler equation. Only the eccentric-anomaly equation and elliptic coordinate transformation are used; no planetary coefficient tables, fitted ephemeris accuracy or Horizons calculation is claimed. Publication date was not verified.
